title: Mat kar Hamein qabool
body:
Lyrics
Mat kar Hame Qabool, Aye Nana (s.a.w.w.) ke madine, Madina Aagaya jub yeh sada ubhar ne lagi
yeh pusht e naka se Kusloom (sa) bain kar ne lagi
<<MINI>>
luta ke aaie hai Zehra (sa) ke hum gharane ko
Na kar qubool madine hamare aane ko... (2)
luta ke aaie hai Zehra (sa) ke hum gharane ko
Na kar qubool madine hamare aane ko..... (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
bataie kaise jo hum par guzar gaya mehshar
sare Hussain (as) tadap ta tha noke naiza par
har ek shaher me mare gai humein patthar
Hamare chehro ke janib thi shamion ki nazar
na hath me the yeh assas mooh chupane ko
<<MINI>>
Na kar qubool madine hamare aane ko..... (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
bichad ke apni bahan se dubara mil na saki, woh dil me legai hasrat madine aane ki
musibanon ke andheron me chal basi bacchi
humein rehai mili woh hai aaj bhi kaidi
basaliya hai Sakina (sa) ne kaid khane ko
<<MINI>>
Na kar qubool madine hamare aane ko..... (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
medina lut gai sarkar tere wali ki
tere Hussain (as) ke sukhe gale pe teg chali
bacha na Aabid e bimar (as) ke siva koi
hamari godhian pardes me hui khali
kadam uthai e nahi jaate ghar me aane ko
<<MINI>>
Na kar qubool madine hamare aane ko..... (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
gali gali me phiraya gaya garibon ko
kadam kadam pe rulaya gaya garibon ko
bicha ke kante chalaya gaya garibo ko
tamsh giron me laaya gaya garibon ko
sawab samjhaya gaya hai humein satane ko
<<MINI>>
Na kar qubool madine hamare aane ko..... (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
tarah tarah se sitamgar humein state the
woh taziano ki beemar ko dawa dete
utha ke saye se woh dhoop me bitha dete
garib Zehra (sa) ka pursa bhala wo kya dete.
naa aaya koi rida bhi humein udha ne ko
<<MINI>>
Na kar qubool madine hamare aane ko..... (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
na likh sakega takallum samaa woh tera qalam
the gird Ahle Medina Ajeeb Tha Alam
Yeh keh ke logo se utre siyanh pos haram
yehan pe chal ne se honga Hussain (as) ka matam
taras gae the hum ashke aza bahane ko.
